question: Why should Registry Context exist as part of CyberAlchemy v2?
answer: It gives every product capability a small, reusable way to obtain the same bounded, owner-qualified, source-current meaning instead of rediscovering or inventing context.
outcomes: agents use the accepted language and owner routes relevant to the work
past evidence remains visible through exact registered selections
capabilities receive bounded context without loading the whole repository
drift and unresolved meaning block or remain visible instead of being guessed
claim_ceiling: Product meaning and intended outcomes only; no outcome effectiveness, adoption, market, release, or deployment claim.
